business_profile.business_overview: A.K. Developments Ltd. is a premium & luxury residential property developer in Dhaka, founded by Engr. Kamruzzaman Mia — a Civil Engineer (B.Sc., MIEB) who served as Chief Engineer on Dubai's Palm Jumeirah. The company has completed and handed over 8 residential buildings across Bashundhara R/A, Baridhara DOHS, Lalbagh, and Hemayetpur (Savar), and is currently constructing 3 projects in Jolshiri Abashon smart city (AK Red Rose, AK Barakah, AK Lakeview). They sell 2850 SFT, 4-bed luxury apartments with 30% down payment and flexible schedules, positioning on 100% legal compliance, RCC frame construction, and guaranteed on-time delivery. 19+ total projects, 5+ prime locations. Their sales intake is a single phone/WhatsApp line (01979-600600).

business_profile.competitive_position: A.K. Developments competes in Jolshiri Abashon against other luxury developers (SEL, Ananta, etc.) all targeting the same affluent buyer pool. Their edge is the founder's Palm Jumeirah credibility and a 100% on-time delivery record. But buyers message multiple developers at once; the one that responds instantly, shows construction progress transparently, and books the site visit first wins. Without an AI buyer agent, A.K. loses the speed-and-transparency race on exactly the multi-crore units where margin is highest.
business_profile.opportunity_size: With 2850 SFT luxury units at premium Jolshiri prices and 30% down payments, each sale is a multi-crore transaction. If slow/manual enquiry handling loses even 1-2 serious buyers per month to faster-responding competitors, that's crores in lost sales value annually. An AI buyer agent that answers instantly, qualifies budget, shows construction progress, and books site visits would directly recover this — and reassure off-plan buyers with automated milestone updates that reduce cancellations.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI buyer-response agent on WhatsApp + website that answers every enquiry in seconds, qualifies budget and timeline, and explains the 30% down-payment schedule.
2. Construction-progress agent that sends automated photo/video milestone updates to off-plan buyers, building trust and reducing cancellation risk.
3. Site-visit scheduler that offers available slots and books viewings with reminders.
4. NRB buyer agent that handles international enquiries across timezones and coordinates remote booking/documentation.
business_profile.demo_scenario: An NRB engineer in Dubai sees A.K. Developments' Palm Jumeirah-founder story and messages the WhatsApp line at 2am Gulf time: 'Is AK Red Rose still available? What's the payment plan?' In seconds the AI replies: 'Yes — 2850 SFT, 4-bed, single unit per floor. 30% down, then flexible milestones. Here's the current construction progress [photos]. Want a video walkthrough or a site visit when you're in Dhaka?' The buyer books a video call. A.K. wakes up to a qualified international buyer they'd have missed overnight — on a multi-crore unit.
